claims.text: A 21-year-old man with eosinophilic esophagitis had upper endoscopy with duodenal biopsies at another institution to screen for celiac disease; the procedure was uneventful. Four days later he was admitted with acute severe abdominal pain that began in the lower abdomen and spread to the right upper quadrant and epigastrium, with right upper quadrant and epigastric tenderness and hypokalemia.
